name: Nitora
tagline: Industrial-grade cleaning, dispatched with clinical precision.
positioning: Nitora brings certified industrial cleaning crews, documented protocols, and compliance-grade records to homeowners, workshop operators, and serious enthusiasts — the same rigor plants trust, sized for you.

hero.h1: Facility-grade cleaning, arranged like a private commission.
hero.sub: Nitora dispatches vetted industrial crews, degreasing, restoration, and hazard-safe protocols to your garage, workshop, or estate — every job logged with the documentation professionals expect.

features.title: Certified crew dispatch
features.description: Every Nitora technician is credential-verified and insured. Book a slot and a rated team arrives with the correct solvents, extraction gear, and a signed scope — not a guess.

features.title: Protocol library
features.description: Concrete degreasing, oxidation removal, mold remediation, ceramic sealing — each service follows a published, versioned procedure you can review before anyone touches a surface.

features.title: Compliance-grade records
features.description: Receive safety data sheets, before-and-after imaging, and a timestamped service manifest for every visit. Ideal for insurance, resale, or your own meticulous files.

features.title: Precision scheduling
features.description: Reserve windows down to the half hour, reschedule without penalty, and track crew arrival in real time. No four-hour waits, no vanishing appointments.

features.title: Surface intelligence
features.description: Log your materials once — epoxy floors, stainless benches, stone counters — and Nitora recommends the correct treatment cadence and flags what to never do again.

features.title: Low-residue chemistry
features.description: Solvents are selected for the substrate and disclosed by name. Fume-controlled, quick-cure, and safe to occupy on the timeline we quote.

testimonials.quote: My restoration workshop passed its first insurance audit in one pass. Nitora's service manifests read like lab reports — the adjuster stopped asking questions.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: I have a stone-floored garage that three companies quietly ruined. Nitora reviewed the substrate, chose a neutral sealer, and documented every step. Immaculate.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: We book Nitora for quarterly degreasing of the bay. Same crew, same protocol, same timestamped photos. That consistency is worth every dollar.
testimonials.name: Elliot Brandt
